name: Jiwa Seorang Pentaksub
overview: Firzan rises from poverty by marrying Anis, the daughter of a politician, in order to seize power. After taking over his deceased father's corrupt political party, his ruthless ambitions destroy their marriage and end with Anis' tragic death. Years later, Firzan shocks his family by wooing and marrying his own daughter's girlfriend, Diana. When his dark secret is revealed, his sons team up with a loyal assistant to expose his crimes and bring him down.
